jobs.occupation: E-bike Mechanic (m,w,d): French/ English in Paris (E-Bike-Servicetechniker/in)
jobs.description:
Start: asap

We are recruiting for a skilled E-Bike Mechanic to join a growing urban mobility team in Paris. You will maintain, diagnose, and repair a fleet of electric bicycles and light electric vehicles, ensuring safe, reliable service for customers. This is an excellent opportunity for a hands-on technician who enjoys troubleshooting electrical and mechanical systems in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.

Your Role

- Perform routine maintenance, inspections, and servicing on e-bikes and associated components (motors, batteries, controllers, brakes, drivetrains, suspension).
- Diagnose and repair electrical faults, mechanical issues, and software or connectivity problems using diagnostic tools and technical documentation.
- Assemble and prepare new e-bikes for deployment, including final quality checks and test rides.
- Replace and fit parts (tyres, tubes, brake pads, cables, batteries) and manage stock of common spare parts and consumables.
- Log work completed and fault findings accurately in the maintenance system, including recommendations for recurring issues.
- Collaborate with operations and customer support to prioritise repairs and respond to urgent service requests.
- Advise colleagues and customers on basic e-bike care, safe operation, and battery handling/storage best practices.
- Maintain a clean, safe workshop environment and follow health & safety procedures at all times.

Your Qualifications

- Proven experience as a bicycle mechanic, ideally with specific experience repairing e-bikes or light electric vehicles.
- Good understanding of electric drivetrain components, battery systems, wiring, and basic electronics; able to read wiring diagrams and use multimeters.
- Competence with standard mechanical tools and workshop equipment, and experience with wheel truing, brake adjustment, and gear indexing.
- Fluent in French; good English is an advantage. Communication should be clear and customer-focused.
- Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Valid right to work in France and willingness to work occasional early starts or weekends as required by operations.
- Relevant vocational qualifications (e.g., cycle mechanic certificate, electrical or mechanical apprenticeship) are desirable but practical experience will be considered.

The Offer

- Permanent full-time contract based in Paris with competitive salary depending on experience.
- Paid training on company-specific e-bike systems and safety procedures.
- Comprehensive benefits package including health coverage contributions and transport allowances.
- Opportunity to work with a sustainable mobility provider and contribute to greener urban transport.
- Supportive, multicultural team environment and clear progression routes within operations and technical roles.
- Modern workshop facilities in Paris, with supplied tools and PPE.

Job Description: 

Airbus Commercial Aircraft is looking for an Engineer in Certification and airworthiness (f/m) to join our Design and Repair certification department based in Toulouse, France.

You will be part of a team providing airworthiness approval to In-Service repair solutions . As part of the Certification team , you will be involved with Customer Care Center matters to give the best repair solution to the customers for them to bring back their aircraft in an airworthy condition after an event. 

Your working environment:

Global capital of aeronautics and European capital for space research, Toulouse is a dynamic city in the southwest of France served by an international airport. Ideally located between the Mediterranean sea and the Atlantic ocean and close to the Pyrenees mountains, it offers plenty of options for outdoor activities! 

How we care for you:

Financial rewards: Attractive salary, agreements on success and profit sharing schemes, employee savings plan abounded by Airbus and employee stock purchase plan on a voluntary basis. 
Work / Life Balance:   Extra days-off for special occasions, holiday transfer option, a Staff council offering many social, cultural and sport activities and other services. 
Wellbeing / Health: Complementary health insurance coverage (disability, invalidity, death). Depending on the site: health services center, concierge services, gym, carpooling application. 
Individual development: Great upskilling opportunities and development prospects  with unlimited access to +10.000 e-learning courses to develop your employability, certifications, expert career path, accelerated development programmes, national and international mobility. 

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly.    

 Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking. 

Your challenges:

We are in close collaboration with all Airbus design offices worldwide. 

 We are working together with two other off-shore teams, in a follow the sun approach : 
 one based in Mobile (USA) 
 one based in Bangalore (India) 

The work will be performed 7 days a week (monday to sunday) in shifts on day time hours by rotation. 

 Your main tasks and responsibilities are: 

Provide Airworthiness approval of in-service repair solutions supported by the Repair and Design Approval Form (RDAF), and Flight Condition Documents (FCD).  

 Interface with Airbus customer services, design offices, chief engineer teams and the other airworthiness departments.  

 Act on request as airworthiness specialists in a multifunctional team to solve Aircraft on Ground situations (AOG). 

 This position is an opportunity to work for all Airbus civil programs, on all ATA chapters and develop multi-skills. 

 Being part of a very dynamic team, you will acquire a high level of overall aircraft knowledge, and enlarge your network within the company. 

After the initial training period, the work will be performed seven days a week (Monday to Sunday) in shifts on daytime hours by rotation. 

Your boarding pass:

You have an advanced level in English. 

 You are educated to degree level (or equivalent) in Engineering or a related discipline. 

You have structure and systems skills. 

 You have a good general knowledge in aeronautics. 

 You have experience in the design office and/or in airworthiness. Knowledge in configuration management is a plus. 

 You are a real collaborative team player, reactive and curious. 

This position requires a security clearance or will require being eligible for clearance by the recognized authorities. 

 Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions. 

 Take your career to a new level and apply online now!

Assistant Buyer (M/F)

Duties:
Be a part of one of our Institute's key missions by joining our Purchasing Service, which is responsible for purchases and contracts with an overall value representing almost half of the ILL's annual budget (of around ?100 million).

As assistant buyer, you will take charge of the following administrative duties:
- Provide our buyers with administrative support by helping them with the following: sending out of invitations to attend meetings, preparation of meetings and drafting of minutes (meetings of internal Purchasing Commission and Purchasing Advisors, meetings with sales representatives, suppliers, etc.)
- Enter, modify and send out orders to suppliers after they have been recorded in our ERP
- Manage the administrative part of the Invitation to Tender process: sending out of invitations to tender, follow-up, summarising and statistical monitoring
- Process orders with a value of less than 5 000 euros, as well as bank card orders
- Monitor dashboards and report regularly to the Head of Service
- Act as contact point for users, buyers and the ILL stores
- Maintain the Purchasing Service's intranet pages
- Manage the purchasing month-end closing process
- Fill in for the secretary of the Purchasing Service when absent with the preparation of minutes of Service meetings, management of office supplies and dealing with the mail.

Qualifications and experience:
- NVQ Level 4 in Business and Administration (or equivalent qualification) specialising in purchasing or international commerce with some initial experience of purchasing or commerce in industry or in the research sector, ideally with an international focus.
- Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office and a firm understanding of an SAP/ORACLE-type ERP application.

As a contact person who communicates information on the ILL's purchasing policy, you combine interpersonal and analytical skills with a meticulous approach to your work. Your ability to manage priorities is an essential asset for this post, which requires efficiency and a proactive attitude.

Language skills:
As an international research centre, we are particularly keen to ensure that we also attract applicants from outside France. You must have a sound knowledge of English and be willing to learn French (a language course will be paid for by the ILL). Knowledge of German would be an advantage.
Benefits: Generous company benefits (expatriation allowance), relocation assistance and language courses may be offered (for more information, please consult our employment conditions).
